subject: [Action] Commit gatekeeper: Q3 board forecast verification
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit gatekeeper: Q3 board forecast verification

Hi all,

We need a short, verifiable commit snapshot for the board packet next week. Requesting the following by EOD Monday (6/15):

- Each AE/AM to lock stages for any deals counted in the committed column of the forecast (SFDC stage -> commit). No "soft-commit" counts.
- A one-line risk note for any deal >$250k that is included in the commit.
- A commitment source file (CSV) that lists deal id, ARR contribution, close date, stage, owner, and the last customer-signed doc (if any). Use the attached commit_template.csv.

I'll collate and hand to Finance for recognition checks. Please copy me when you update the template; I will keep a changelog.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: commit_template.csv (CSV stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit gatekeeper: Q3 board forecast verification

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 09:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> We need a short, verifiable commit snapshot for the board packet next week.

All right — I pulled the current commit column and ran a quick reconciliation against bookings pipeline. Notes below and I've attached the CSV export.

Snapshot (committed bookings, as of 2026-06-12):
- Total committed bookings (Q3): $4,720,000 (expected recognition schedule under review)
- Net new ARR implied by commits: $3.1M run-rate (annualized where appropriate)
- ARR per Finance ledger: $48.2M (rolling L12M ARR) — Finance flagged two deals with non-standard payment terms.

At-risk items:
1) ACME Corp (deal #ACME-2026Q3) — $1.2M. Signed LOI but legal wants a specific data-retention clause; target close slips to 7/9. Risk: medium-high.
2) Borealis Health (deal #BOR-77) — $620k. Customer procurement delayed; expected revised PO by 6/25, risk: medium.

Next actions I'll take:
- Lock confirmed commits in the attached pipeline_status_cut_20260612.csv (please do not edit).
- Send final list to Finance for recognition exceptions.

Attachment: pipeline_status_cut_20260612.csv (CSV stub)

Vivek
Senior Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit gatekeeper: Q3 board forecast verification

On Fri, Jun 12, 2026 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Snapshot (committed bookings, as of 2026-06-12): ...

Thanks — saw the pipe cut. I reviewed the $4.72M and made a small adjustment: removed one large ARR that was double-counted (salesforce sync issue). Revised committed bookings = $4,215,000. I updated close dates where AEs confirmed pushes to July.

Draft board blurb for the "Bookings & ARR" slide (feel free to shorten):
"Redwood closed Q2 with L12M ARR of $48.2M. Current committed bookings for Q3 total $4.2M; recognition timing will be subject to contract finalization and payment terms. Two material opportunities flagged for potential timing risk; Finance has the exception logs and legal is triaging redlines. We expect to present a conservative recognized forecast at the board meeting.

Action requested from sales: ensure deal-stage hygiene and route any new contract redlines to legal under the 'board packet' priority.
"
I'll attach a narrative draft for the packet.

Attachment: Q3_board_narrative_draft.docx (DOCX stub)

—Laura
Head of Finance (Interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit gatekeeper: Q3 board forecast verification

Thanks — quick confirm that the cut file looks clean.

Two quick asks before I drop into the slide deck:
1) Can someone provide a one-liner (25 words max) that captures the finance position on recognition we can put in the header? Example: "Conservative recognition approach: only legally-executed contracts with payment terms meeting policy included in recognized forecast."
2) For any >$250k commit where legal redlines are outstanding, add a single-sentence status (owner + blocker).

Suggested one-liner for the deck: "We are presenting a conservative recognized forecast; committed bookings reflect signed deals or those with fully-accepted payment terms."
If that works, I'll bake into slide 3.

—Dev (Revenue Ops)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. I've consolidated the locked commits and the narrative into the board packet. Key callouts in the packet:
- L12M ARR: $48.2M (unchanged)
- Committed bookings (Q3 conservative recognized view): $4.2M
- Material risks: ACME Corp ($1.2M) and Borealis Health ($620k) — legal/finance notes included.

Drive folder with final assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q3-board-packet (Board Ops link)

Board Ops / Ashley — sharing now for distribution. We are on the 6/22 board packet deadline; please flag if you need additional reconciliations.

Hannah Schmitt

Redwood Inference
